exceptions.meaning: A value JCS cannot represent: a non-finite number or a duplicate member name (A01 rule 1).
A named record does not exist; the reason names the first missing record (State 5 code unknown_reference).
An operation's own check failed; the reason names the first failing check (State 5 code refused).
A continuation token is malformed or names no position of that list (State 5 code invalid_request, A16 rule 6).
A store call broke one of the store's own invariants or its transaction failed; nothing was written (State 5 internal_error).
The configuration file fails a start check; the start stops (A17 rule 1, A16 rule 1).
A service credential reference does not resolve while a request is built (A17 rule 2).
bubblewrap is missing or the start probe execution failed; the start stops (A03 rule 8).
An execution's cleanup could not be confirmed and its record is written; the process must stop (A03 rule 7).
